title: 「That said」承認前點後再作轉折
titleEn: Using that said to acknowledge a point before qualifying it

source.file: Sentence Structure 142 -「That said」承認前點後再作轉折.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Complete statement. That said, + contrasting or qualifying statement

formulas.formula: Complete statement. That said, + contrasting or qualifying statement

example: The plan has clear strengths. That said, the risks should not be ignored.
exampleZh: 這個計劃有明顯優點。不過，風險也不應被忽視。

examples.en: The plan has clear strengths. That said, the risks should not be ignored.
examples.zh: 這個計劃有明顯優點。不過，風險也不應被忽視。

rules.zh: 前面必須有一個完整意思 That said 通常回應前一句的整體內容，因此不能在沒有上文的情況下隨意使用。
rules.en: A complete idea must come before that said because the phrase responds to the preceding statement as a whole and cannot be used without context.
examples: The hotel is expensive. That said, the service is excellent.
That said, the service is excellent.

rules.zh: 在本練習中，That said 放在第二句句首 That 的 T 要使用大寫，而 said 後面要加逗號。
rules.en: In this exercise, begin the second sentence with That said,. Capitalize That and put a comma after said.

rules.zh: 第二句應加入轉折、限制或不同角度 第二句不是完全否定第一句，而是令整體判斷更加完整和平衡。
rules.en: The second sentence should add contrast, limitation or another perspective. It should not completely negate the first point, but should make the overall judgement fuller and more balanced.
examples: The course is useful. That said, it requires a lot of time.

rules.zh: 不要同時使用兩個轉折連接詞
rules.en: Do not use two contrast linkers together.
examples: The plan is useful. That said, it is expensive.

rules.zh: That said 和 however 不完全相同 However 可以用來表示一般的相反關係。 That said 通常含有「我承認剛才那一點，不過仍有另一點需要考慮」的意思，因此特別適合用來 作出平衡判斷。
rules.en: That said acknowledges the preceding point before qualifying it, so it is not identical to however. However can mark a general contrast; that said carries the sense ‘I accept the point just made, but another consideration remains’ and is especially suitable for balanced judgement.

benefits.zh: 讓你的觀點更加平衡 你可以先承認一項優點或事實，再提出限制或問題，避免令說話聽起來過於片面。
benefits.en: It makes your viewpoint more balanced by acknowledging a benefit or fact before adding a limitation or problem, avoiding an overly one-sided impression.
examples: The idea is creative. That said, it may be difficult to carry out.

benefits.zh: 令轉折更加自然 相比突然使用 but 否定前面的內容，That said 能讓讀者感覺你已經考慮過上一點，再自然地轉 到另一個角度。
benefits.en: It creates a more natural transition. Rather than abruptly using but to reject what came before, That said shows that the earlier point has been considered before shifting to another angle.

benefits.zh: 幫助你提出重要的保留或提醒 你可以在承認好處之後，加入風險、例外、限制或需要注意的地方。
benefits.en: It helps you add an important reservation or reminder by introducing a risk, exception, limitation or point requiring attention after acknowledging a benefit.
examples: This medicine is effective. That said, it may cause drowsiness.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 but 和 however 這個句型為你提供另一種表達轉折的方法，令說話和寫作的句式更多變。
benefits.en: It avoids repeatedly using but and however and gives speech and writing greater structural variety.

benefits.zh: 適合討論、作文、報告和工作溝通 在分析計劃、給予意見、評估表現或比較利弊時，這個句型可以幫助你表達成熟而有分寸的判 斷。
benefits.en: It suits discussions, essays, reports and workplace communication. When analysing plans, giving advice, evaluating performance or weighing advantages and disadvantages, it helps you express a mature, measured judgement.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.
